messages:
zoe.partnerships: Quick check-in — final items for cloud marketplace listing: logos, alt-text, EULA blurb, and contact email. Can we close these today?

mika.marketing: I have the hero + square logos ready. Need to confirm alt-text for accessibility. Suggest: 'Redwood Inference logo: stylized redwood tree with gradient red'. Thoughts?

noah.legal: EULA blurb ready. Short version for listing: 'Use governed by Redwood Inference Terms and Publisher Agreement. Enterprise customers contact sales for custom terms.' Provide DPA link on request.

ade.ops: Ops contact is ops-marketplace@redwood.ai. Also we need to confirm that AMI/VM images are final before we hand artifacts to marketplace packaging. I'll create a staging bucket and share path.

marketplace-bot: Asset upload detected: /internal/assets/marketplace/1781234567/logos uploaded by mika.marketing. Validation: filenames OK.

zoe.partnerships: Mika please update alt-text to include file format and color contrast note. Noah can you paste the exact EULA line into the PR description? Ade will you share the staging bucket path here?

mika.marketing: Updated alt-text: 'Redwood Inference logo (SVG, high-contrast red gradient)'. Uploaded new file.

noah.legal: Pasting EULA line to PR: 'By using this listing you agree to Redwood Inference Terms: https://redwood.ai/terms. Enterprise agreements and DPAs available upon request.'

ade.ops: Staging bucket: gs://redwood-marketplace-staging/1781234567. I'll upload AMI manifest by EOD and ping packaging.

zoe.partnerships: Great. Owners: Mika (assets), Noah (legal blurb), Ade (artifacts). I'll merge the PR after confirmations. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
